records.context: Turning module animation back *on* only resumes the widgets that are actually on application view. Every module application view keeps its ambient widget alive while the user is on some other tab, and un-pausing those would spend frames on pixels nobody can see — which is the one thing this animation is not allowed to do. Their own ``showEvent`` restarts them when the tab comes back.
records.label: spacr.qt.preferences.apply_ambient_preferences#3
records.source: Turning module animation back *on* only resumes the widgets that are actually on screen. Every module screen keeps its ambient widget alive while the user is on some other tab, and un-pausing those would spend frames on pixels nobody can see — which is the one thing this animation is not allowed to do. Their own ``showEvent`` restarts them when the tab comes back.
records.translation: Þegar hreyfing eininga er *virkjuð* aftur halda aðeins þeir viðmótshlutir sem raunverulega sjást á skjánum áfram. Hver einingaskjár heldur bakgrunnsbúnaði sínum lifandi meðan notandinn er á öðrum flipa; að ræsa hann aftur myndi eyða römmum í myndpunkta sem enginn sér — einmitt það sem þessi hreyfing má ekki gera. Eigin ``showEvent`` þeirra ræsir þá aftur þegar flipinn birtist aftur.
